environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in a private subnet. Access is provided via AWS Client VPN endpoint to internal developers. The NLB performs TCP passthrough on port 443 with TLS termination at the application. No request inspection or filtering layer exists between the VPN clients and the application. SQLite database file is on an EBS volume mounted at /var/app/data/. Security group allows inbound TCP/443 from the VPN CIDR (10.0.0.0/8).
